Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1112
Claimant:
Theresa Espinoza
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
10-1-23
Claim opened after a report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second
vehicle. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office. The driver
is named on the policy.
10-29-23
Police report received and reviewed. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the incident. Scene
photos were submitted by the insured and show damage consistent with the reported impact.
11-10-23
Adjuster inspected the vehicle and found damage that matches the described impact. No earlier damage to the
vehicle is known from prior claims or inspection records. Nothing suggests the damage predates the start of
coverage.
11-11-23
Attorney letter received with the claimant's written statement of the collision. The statement describes the sequence
of events and the position of both vehicles. No independent witnesses have come forward to date.
12-15-23
Medical records received showing a shoulder injury. The reported injury fits the kind and force of the crash. Prior
medical history reviewed, and no earlier injury to the same body area is known.
12-18-23
Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up visits. Records show the claimant's
symptoms improved steadily, and treatment tapered off as recovery progressed.
12-27-23
Claimant provided a supplemental statement through counsel adding a few minor details about the moments before
impact. The core account of the collision remained the same as the original statement.
2-3-24
Photos submitted by the claimant were compared with the polcie report and the adjuster's inspection notes. They
confirm some details of the scene, though they do not show the moment of impact.
2-26-24
Reviewed the medical bills against the treatment records. The charges line up with the care documented and the
recovery timeline described by the treating provider.
4-24-24
Claim file reviewed and ready for the next step in the evaluation. Coverage confirmed for the driver named on the
policy. Next action is to finalize the injury assessment with counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
